description: Wait until a label (or @ref) is on screen — or, with gone, until it is not. With settle and no target: until the screen, its picture included, holds still for a second, for web pages with no labels to wait for (a sign-in page loading).

device.description: Simulator UDID or adb serial, when several are booted. Remembered for later calls

platform.description: When both an iOS and an Android device are booted. Remembered for later calls

name: wait
